title: Amulet of Elemental Torment
summary: When the wearer stands in certain surfaces and casts a damaging spell, the spell target also receives that surface’s condition.

fields.Effect: A damaging spell can transfer a condition from the surface beneath the wearer to the target for 2 turns.
fields.Base value: 65 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Surfaces: Fire applies Burning and immediately deals 1d4 Fire. Caustic Brine applies its condition and immediately deals 1d4 Acid. Simple Toxin applies Poisoned. Acid applies Acid.
fields.Limits: Other surfaces, including Ice, Electrified Water and stronger toxin surfaces, do not trigger the passive.

changes: Reconciled the item and linked gameplay rules with their pinned BG3 Wiki revisions, including item-specific qualifiers.
